follow-up time: Postpartum until discharge and 30 days postpartum
cohort: Patients with preeclampsia with severe features who delivered at a tertiary, urban, academic medical center over a one-year period
finding: Pulmonary edema was associated with increased odds of severe maternal morbidity, extended postpartum length of stay, and intensive care unit admission among patients with severe preeclampsia.
gest_age: Earlier gestational age at diagnosis of preeclampsia and at delivery in patients with pulmonary edema
